name: Hover Image Reveal List
use: A big-type list of project or service links. Hovering a row floats its image under the cursor with a lagged, tilting follow; other rows dim and the arrow nudges. Touch screens get inline thumbnails instead.
notes: Over the 8 KB budget (11.6 KB unminified): image pairing (click-through link match, then order), two display modes (floating image / touch thumbnails), keyboard focus and reduced-motion paths. Paired Image Blocks are hidden with visibility:hidden, so they keep their grid space: stack them in one small cell (desktop and mobile layout). Big row type applies on the live site only; the editor shows the Text Block's own style.
